description: Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka -  Licence Rules in terms of Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act.
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules and regulations for telecommunications provider licenses issued by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission under the Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act. It establishes legal frameworks, compliance requirements, and regulatory procedures for licensing telecommunications infrastructure services, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
